connector.name: UniFi Gateway
connector.registryDescription: Safe-by-default UniFi MCP: Network + Protect + Access, multi-site, dry-run, audit log.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the container image mcp-unifi:0.15.4. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the pete-builds account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: STUB_MODE
env.description: When true, the server returns realistic mock data and requires no UniFi hardware. Defaults to true so the image is functional out of the box.

env.name: UNIFI_HOST
env.description: IP address or hostname of the UniFi OS gateway (UCG-Fiber, UDM Pro, etc). Required when STUB_MODE=false and MCP_UNIFI_CONTROLLERS_FILE is unset.

env.name: UNIFI_API_KEY
env.description: Local API key generated under Settings -> Control Plane -> Integrations on the gateway. Required when STUB_MODE=false and MCP_UNIFI_CONTROLLERS_FILE is unset.

env.name: UNIFI_SITE
env.description: UniFi controller site name. Defaults to 'default'.

env.name: UNIFI_VERIFY_SSL
env.description: Whether to verify the gateway's TLS certificate. Defaults to false because most home gateways use a self-signed cert.

env.name: MCP_UNIFI_CONTROLLERS_FILE
env.description: Path to a YAML file describing multiple named controllers for multi-site management. When set, the legacy UNIFI_HOST / UNIFI_API_KEY env vars are ignored. Each entry needs name, host, api_key, and optionally port, site, verify_ssl.

env.name: MCP_UNIFI_MODULES_ENABLED
env.description: Comma-separated list of modules to load. Known values: 'network', 'protect', 'access'. Defaults to 'network'. Set to 'network,protect,access' to enable Protect and Access tools alongside Network. Access is read-only in v0.10.

env.name: UNIFI_ACCESS_HOST
env.description: UniFi Access hub IP or hostname. Required when the access module is enabled and STUB_MODE=false. Often the same host as UNIFI_HOST.

env.name: UNIFI_ACCESS_API_KEY
env.description: UniFi Access API key. Separate from the Network API key; generated on the Access controller's developer settings. Required when the access module is enabled and STUB_MODE=false.

env.name: UNIFI_ACCESS_PORT
env.description: HTTPS port for the Access hub. Defaults to 12445 (the direct Access app port).

env.name: MCP_UNIFI_AUDIT_SINK
env.description: Audit log sink. One of 'file' (default), 'stdout', or 'syslog'. Every tool call is recorded to a JSONL stream with secrets scrubbed.

env.name: MCP_UNIFI_AUDIT_PATH
env.description: Path for the audit log file when MCP_UNIFI_AUDIT_SINK=file. Defaults to audit.jsonl in the process CWD.
